summary: The requirement document asks for one web system for a 180-bed hospital in Nagpur, replacing paper registers and Excel sheets. It covers online appointments, medical records, beds, lab, pharmacy stock, billing and dashboards, with support for two years after go-live.

evidence.quote: Patients shall book OPD appointments online with a chosen doctor and time slot, and front-desk staff shall book walk-in visits.

stories: As a patient, I can book an OPD appointment online with a chosen doctor and time slot
As a front-desk staff member, I can book a walk-in visit

evidence.quote: The system shall send an SMS reminder to the patient a day before the appointment.

stories: As a patient, I get an SMS reminder a day before my appointment

evidence.quote: Patients shall be able to pay the consultation fee online when booking.

stories: As a patient, I can pay the consultation fee online when booking

evidence.quote: Doctors and staff shall sign in with their existing hospital Microsoft accounts (single sign-on through the hospital's Active Directory).

stories: As a doctor, I can sign in with my existing hospital Microsoft account

evidence.quote: The pharmacy shall keep stock of medicines with batch numbers and expiry dates, and get an alert when stock is low.

stories: As a pharmacist, I can keep stock of medicines with batch numbers and expiry dates
As a pharmacist, I get an alert when stock is low

evidence.quote: Billing staff shall create patient bills with GST for consultations, bed charges, lab tests and medicines, and print receipts.

stories: As billing staff, I can create a patient bill with GST and print the receipt

evidence.quote: Patients shall upload old reports (PDF or photos) to their record.

stories: As a patient, I can upload old reports to my record

evidence.quote: The administrator shall see dashboards of daily OPD visits, bed occupancy, collections and pharmacy stock value.

stories: As the administrator, I can see dashboards of daily OPD visits, bed occupancy, collections and pharmacy stock value

evidence.quote: Patient records of the last five years shall be moved from the existing Excel sheets into the new system.

stories: As the administrator, I can have the last five years of patient records moved from Excel into the system

evidence.quote: Screens shall be available in English and Hindi.

stories: As a user, I can use the screens in English or Hindi

other_features.name: Electronic medical records
other_features.description: Doctors record each visit's diagnosis, notes and prescriptions in the patient's record and see past visits.
stories: As a doctor, I can record a visit's diagnosis, notes and prescriptions in the patient's record
As a doctor, I can see the patient's past visits

evidence.quote: Doctors shall record each visit's diagnosis, notes and prescriptions in the patient's electronic medical record, and see the patient's past visits.

other_features.name: Ward and bed management
other_features.description: Nurses see free beds in each ward and admit, transfer and discharge patients.
stories: As a nurse, I can see which beds are free in each ward
As a nurse, I can admit a patient to a bed
As a nurse, I can transfer a patient to another bed
As a nurse, I can discharge a patient

evidence.quote: Nurses shall see which beds are free in each ward, admit patients to a bed, transfer them and discharge them.

other_features.name: Lab test orders and results
other_features.description: Doctors order lab tests and lab technicians enter results that appear in the patient's record.
stories: As a doctor, I can order lab tests
As a lab technician, I can enter test results that appear in the patient's record

evidence.quote: Doctors shall order lab tests; lab technicians shall enter results, which appear in the patient's record.
The vendor shall host the system on an Indian cloud and provide support for two years after go-live during hospital office hours.
The vendor shall host the system on an Indian cloud and provide support for two years after go-live during hospital office hours.
A separate mobile app is not required; the web system shall work on phones and tablets.
